about: Each dealer's named trees (Jakob 2026-11-21: several trees per dealer, each with a name, about three at most; everything else is loose material that can later be deleted). A tree is a set of anchors from data/media-roles.json, by entry id: the root (A1) and the anchors it branches into, written in his notation by tools/dealer-tree.ts from the graph's nodes (IDLE = A1, READY = A2.1, READY-B = A2.2, READY-C = A2.3, a card node such as P4.C1 = A3P4C1). Films are not listed here: the tool finds every film whose first and last pictures are the tree's anchors. state: spelas (the game plays it), byggs (being made), vilar (resting). name is what Jakob sees and his to change. shares: the id of another tree of the same dealer whose anchors and films this one plays too (such a tree is the other seen another way and is not one of the three); opening: a media-roles film outside the bank that leads into the root (the film before the game). An anchor may carry seat (1-7) when its picture is seen from that seat instead of the straight camera; the tool then writes S2-A2.2. seat is set only where a register says the angle. The straight camera is seat 4's: the tree's nodes, its 36 steps, its number and what the game plays are that camera's, and an anchor with another seat, with the films that stand on it, is the same tree from that seat's camera (Karta's camera strip, ?kamera=2), never played as a straight film. A tree is measured against his measure (src/dealer-trees.ts, 'en giv per kort'): 36 steps from its first A2.x anchor, the anchor at the shoe; its other A2.x anchors stand in for it where its own film is missing (the Casino gives P6C1 from A2.2). One way of dealing is one tree (Jakob 2026-11-24: 'två olika nodträd ... Både från 2.1 och från 2.3'): two trees of the same hands rest on the same A1 and differ at the shoe. A film that stands only on the picture they have in common (rest, talk, the hole card) is the first of them's in this list, and the other borrows it in a composition (data/dealer-compositions.json). Read by tools/dealer-tree.ts, which writes its report to .runtime/dealer-trad/ and serves GET /api/trees to Karta.

trees.name: Casino
trees.note: The older hands, resting since Jakob 2026-11-24 ("vi ska köra enbart med hennes nya händer och de tatuerade klippen"); the game played it until then, and ?trad=casino still does. Every film of this tree was made from these pictures, and the tree keeps them, although Jakob archived paow-vila-ung-2 and paow-ankare-2-2-t1 in Material (2026-11-23). Its A2.2 is used by one step: the deal to P6C1, whose Primär starts there.

trees.name: Ingången
trees.note: The way into the Casino through the film before the game (/trailer): the film ends on the Casino's A1 and the game goes on with the Casino's own films. Rests with the Casino since 2026-11-24; a film that ends on the tattooed A1 is not made yet.

trees.name: Tatuerad
trees.note: What the game plays since 2026-11-24 (Jakob: "vi ska köra enbart med hennes nya händer och de tatuerade klippen"). The tattooed set where she pushes the card out, from A2.3 (Jakob 2026-11-21; 2026-11-24: "A2.3 så skjuter hon ut kort"): A1 paow-vila-tatuerad; A2.3 paow-ankare-2-3-d with two hands, the anchor at the shoe, her gaze down on the card (Jakob 2026-11-23 in Beslut: "Ja, byt blicken"). It has no A2.2: he archived paow-ankare-2-2-blick-a in Material 2026-11-23 ("Ser inte att den används"), and no film of the tree started there. paow-ankare-2-3-c was the A2.3 until then, the same picture with her gaze to the side: it stays among the anchors, after the one that holds, so that the films that begin or end on it stay in the tree until they are remade (the first anchor given for a node is the node's picture). The A3 anchor for P4 is taken from the first deal of that earlier A2.3. It stands before Tatuerad nyp, so the films on their common A1 (rest, talk, the hole card) are this tree's. Her tattooed A2.1 is the tree Tatuerad nyp.

trees.name: Tatuerad nyp
trees.note: The tattooed set where she pinches the card, from A2.1 (Jakob 2026-11-24: "Det gamla 2.1-ankaret är när hon nyper"; her smaller hands, faster, with the tattoos). The same A1 as Tatuerad, so the two are put together in a composition without a bridge at rest. A2.1 paow-nyp-tatuerad (Jakob 2026-11-23 in Beslut: ja on tatuerat-a21-kandidat) is the last frame of the film from A1 to the shoe, paow-ingang-2-1-tatuerad-01. Its deals are made from that anchor through the doll (seat 4 first, then 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7): a film ordered from paow-nyp-tatuerad is this tree's by its first picture, whatever tree the order named.
